ezlynx.notes: REST API + webhooks. Activation via BGI Agency / EZLynx Support ticket #1943345.

outlook.notes: Microsoft Graph API. Used for inbox triage rules + auto-responder + send.

wordpress.notes: Gravity Forms webhook → lead-intake. Replaces broken Zapier bridge.

lightspeed.notes: VoIP. API surface uncertain. Phase 2 candidate for call-transcription.

wonderwrite.notes: ACORD form digitization. API availability unconfirmed.

n8n.notes: Hosting decision deferred. Workflow JSON exports staged under each automation's n8n/ folder.

modeContract.test: All outbound (email, SMS, API writes) must target testRecipient OR be no-op'd. test-mode-guard.mjs enforces.
modeContract.production: Outbound sends to productionRecipients per workflow. Requires explicit per-workflow promotion checklist in workflow README.

llm.providerNotes: ollama | claude | none. Default ollama (local, free, private). Customer flips to claude with their own ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for higher quality. 'none' forces deterministic-only paths (classifier rules, no LLM calls).

ollama.modelNotes: hermes3 (~8B) chosen as default because it's already pulled in Adrian's local Ollama and runs on modest hardware. Customers with GPUs should override to gemma3:27b or larger for sharper analysis.

claude.billing: Customer's Anthropic account. Hirobius never sees usage or billing.

none.behavior: Throws if a workflow attempts an LLM call. Forces deterministic-only execution. Safe default for paranoid privacy postures.

outlook.mailboxNote: Production mailbox. For dev-tenant testing, override via MS_GRAPH_TEST_MAILBOX in .env.local.
outlook.applyModeNote: tag = set Outlook category only. move = also move to folder. both = tag + move.
